s.note: the hidden island of the Amazons
s.how: Griddle 250g sliced haloumi until golden and squeeze lemon over. Drizzle 150g feta with honey and thyme. Arrange on a big platter with olives, 4 halved figs and 4 warm pita breads.

Mix 300g beef mince with a diced potato and onion and plenty of pepper. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, fill and fold into half moons. Crimp, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with English mustard.

m.note: the night the village celebrates and dances
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly, add 375ml dark beer, thyme, bay and 1 tbsp Dijon. Braise at 160C for 3 hours. Fry 1kg potatoes into frites, at 140C then 180C, and serve alongside.

w.n: Diana's raspberry ripple ice cream cones
w.note: she tells the vendor he should be very proud
w.how: Heat 300ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 egg yolks with 120g caster sugar, whisk in the hot milk and cook to 82C, stirring. Strain and chill overnight, then churn. Simmer 200g frozen raspberries with 50g sugar for 5 minutes, sieve and cool. Layer the ice cream and sauce in a container, swirl once with a knife and freeze 4 hours. Scoop into cones.

d.n: Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey
d.note: a toast in the freed village of Veld
d.how: Simmer the peeled zest of 1 orange with 60g honey, 60ml water and a pinch of crushed coriander seed for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. Put 1 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon in each of 4 chilled stemmed glasses. Pour a 330ml Belgian white ale slowly into each so it builds a head, and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
